description.value: Quality Greens is a locally focused farm market that has been supporting Okanagan growers and suppliers for over 25 years, offering fresh produce, a gourmet deli with grab-and-go options, dairy, bakery, and a full grocery department. The store operates under a 'Down to Earth' environmental philosophy, using compostable packaging, accepting reusable bags, and carrying Fair Trade, organic, and Non-GMO products. For a touring cyclist resupplying in Penticton, it offers a broad range of fresh and prepared foods in a single stop.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is fully available and confirms Quality Greens is a legitimate, operating grocery store at 102-300 Riverside Drive, Penticton, BC. The site details a full-service market with produce, deli, dairy, bakery, and grocery departments, supporting the OSM 'supermarket' tag and 'Groceries' category. No mention of bike parking, water bottle refill, or any cycling-specific amenities appears anywhere on the site, so those fields are null.
